items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: Dave, you once mentioned you were playing in a place, and Francis Domino was playing in the same place before he was discovered... Tell me about this, where was this place? Well, they called it The Hideaway.

ctx.x: Dave, you once mentioned you were playing in a place, and Francis Domino was playing in the same place before he was discovered, before he made a hit. Tell me about this, where was this place?
Well, they called it The Hideaway.
